meta.title: Sarah & David
meta.description: Together with our families, we invite you to celebrate our wedding. Find all the details and RSVP here.

eventDetails.title: We can't wait to celebrate with you
eventDetails.body: After years of love and laughter, we are overjoyed to invite you to share in our simcha. Join us for a chuppah under the stars, followed by dinner, dancing and pure joy late into the night.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Here's how the evening will unfold.

rsvp.body: We would be honoured to have you join us. Kindly let us know below.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: Have a question about the day? Send us a note and we'll reply soon.

items.question: What time should I arrive?
items.answer: Please arrive by 6:00 PM so we can begin the chuppah promptly at 7:00 PM.

items.question: Is the meal kosher?
items.answer: Yes. The entire event is glatt kosher. Please note any additional dietary needs in your RSVP.

items.question: Can I bring a guest?
items.answer: Your invitation indicates the number of seats reserved for you. Please list everyone in your party when you RSVP.

items.question: Where should I park?
items.answer: Complimentary valet parking is available at the venue's main entrance.

footer.message: We can't wait to celebrate with you
